extracted.intended_audience: Researchers and research administrators at UK research organisations seeking EPSRC funding
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and metadata for applying to EPSRC funding opportunities (eligibility, funding terms, deadlines, and fit to the stated aims). Intended to inform prospective applicants how an opportunity is structured and any explicit application constraints.

rubrics_metrics.name: Institutional eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: You must be based at a UK research organisation eligible for EPSRC funding.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is an explicit eligibility requirement for the listed opportunities (for example, the Centre for Quantum Commercialisation Skills). Applicants must be hosted by an institution recognised as eligible by EPSRC; check your organisation's eligibility before preparing an application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Invitation-only application requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: You must be invited to apply for this funding opportunity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applies to the 'UKRI metascience scientometrics for research assessment' opportunity which is invite-only. Only those who receive an invitation may submit an application; unsolicited applications will not be accepted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Funding rate / full economic cost (FEC) expectation
rubrics_metrics.description: We expect to fund up to £3 million at 80% full economic cost (FEC).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should prepare project budgets on the basis that EPSRC (and co-funders for this competition) plan to fund at 80% of FEC; ensure costing reflects the required contribution level and any co-funder requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Award range
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For the 'Centre for Quantum Commercialisation Skills' opportunity: proposals should request funding within this indicated range and design scope commensurate with this scale.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application opening and closing dates/times
rubrics_metrics.description: Opening date and time and closing date and time are specified in UK time (e.g., Opening: 6 May 2026 9:00am UK time; Closing: 7 July 2026 4:00pm UK time).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants must submit by the stated closing time (UK time). Allow for institution internal approvals and submission system (UKRI) timings; late submissions are typically not accepted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Project fit to opportunity aims
rubrics_metrics.description: Apply for funding to establish a UK centre for quantum commercialisation skills that will provide opportunities for researchers to develop commercialisation skills, engage with industry, and explore new career pathways.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposals should demonstrate clear alignment with these stated aims (skills development, industry engagement, commercialisation pathways). Projects that do not address the core objectives of the specific opportunity are unlikely to be competitive.
